members.name: Two brothers (based out of Toronto, Canada)

podcast.title: Band Member's Surprise at Search
podcast.body: One of the brothers from Wave Station was reportedly very surprised to learn that their old song had become the subject of a massive online search as a Lost Wave track. "No one is more surprised than him that this old song has been the subject of a massive online Lost Wave search."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Brief Prominence and Disappearance
podcast.body: Wave Station experienced a period of being "hot for a minute" after their 1991 song release, but then disappeared from the public eye for years, leading to their track becoming a "Lost Wave" mystery. "Wave Station was hot for a minute and then disappeared for years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
